title: Use Story stars in decisions about what to publish
description: Surface stars where editors and the automation choose what moves forward: the Stories board sort and a minimum-stars filter, the Notification Center, and the signals the idea pipeline reads (src/papyrus_content/ideas/signal_inputs.py reads Reference stars today). Coordinate with the automation session's work. Stars inform and order; they do not publish or reject anything on their own unless Ryan decides that.
